about: A mod listed in mods.settings that replaces a whole definition file would win over ItemXL's output mod, and so would Script Merger's mod0000_MergedFiles with a merged definition file: the report says so. With the output mod listed before them, there is nothing to say (case order).

report_contains: modWhole replaces gameplay/items/def_item_bolts.xml and is listed in mods.settings before mod00000_ItemXL
mod0000_MergedFiles replaces gameplay/items/def_item_bolts.xml and is listed in mods.settings before mod00000_ItemXL
